name: retro
description: Learns from finished agent runs: /retro:distill turns a run's transcript (Claude Code, a Cursor export, a pasted chat) into a skill for next time or tightens the skill it used; /retro:agent-audit checks each sub-agent against its brief and says who owns each problem (the brief, the agent, the host or the model), across sessions an eval of a skill's briefs
